How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for IIT Delhi Project Scientist Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 18-09-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Project Scientist position at IIT Delhi?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your completed application via email is 18th September 2026. Ensure your application reaches the designated email address before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the minimum qualification required for the Project Scientist role?
faq.answer: The minimum qualification required is a Master's degree in Economics with First Division or Merit. Additional skills and experience are also essential.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary offered for the Project Scientist position?
faq.answer: The consolidated fellowship or pay-slab ranges from Rs. 47,790 to Rs. 62,350/- per month, plus HRA at 30%.

faq.question: Q4. How can I apply for the Project Scientist vacancy at IIT Delhi?
faq.answer: You need to download the application form from the IRD website, fill it completely, and submit it via email to [email protected] with the advertisement number in the subject line.

faq.question: Q5. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve an online interview. Candidates will be shortlisted based on their application and qualifications.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this post?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What kind of experience is required for the Project Scientist role?
faq.answer: You need at least six months of research experience, such as an intern, research assistant, or project scientist, along with experience in handling large datasets and specific software.

faq.question: Q8. Which software proficiencies are necessary for this position?
faq.answer: Proficiency in Stata, Python, and LaTeX (Overleaf) is required for data analysis and academic writing purposes.

faq.question: Q9. What is the total number of vacancies available?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy for the Project Scientist position at IIT Delhi.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification can be accessed through the Important Links section of this article, which provides a direct link to the PDF document.
